_comment: Single source of truth for all subnet settings. Edit here; validator and platform both read this file. No restart needed — validator reloads each step, platform reads fresh on each request.
_emissionSplitComment: Winner vs qualifying non-winners pool; must sum to 1.0. Loaded by incentive.py and platform read-config.
_criticPoolComment: maxCriticsPerValidator caps pool size per validator. criticScoreClipThreshold clips outlier critic scores before median (Yuma-inspired); only applies at 3+ critics in the pool.
_criteriaComment: Screening criteria weights (0–1, must sum to 1.0). Changing these requires a platform deploy — client display and server scoring both read from here.
